ONE CONNECTED SYSTEM

Plan it. Do it. Track it.
Then let NUFI help with what’s next.

Everything talks to everything else, so your plan stays useful instead of becoming another abandoned spreadsheet.

1

Tell us about you

Your goals, preferences, available time and starting point set the targets. No hidden assumptions.

2

Follow today’s plan

Meals, workouts and your next useful action stay visible. Protein remaining comes first.

3

Log what actually happened

Planned versus eaten and planned versus completed reconcile clearly. Your edits remain your truth.

4

Adjust without drama

NUFI shows what changed, why it changed and what to do next. No mystery maths.
